events.title: Toonie Tuesday Coffee Celebration
events.imageAlt: Freshly brewed Isaiah Café drip coffee
events.description: At Isaiah Café, the Toonie Tuesday event transforms a regular Tuesday into a celebration of community and great coffee. Guests are welcomed with genuine smiles and the comforting hum of a bustling bakery, where the scent of fresh pastries mingles with the rich notes of specialty brews. The $2 coffee offer invites you to linger, chat, and make new connections

events.title: Work & Connect Wednesdays
events.description:

students
